name: Refactor ChangesPanel to dropdown selector
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Initial Request**: User asked to convert the project selector from horizontal tabs into a dropdown menu to reduce UI clutter and improve space efficiency.

2. **Layout Restructuring**: The project selector dropdown and branch selector were moved into the same control row, eliminating the separate project tabs section.

3. **Dropdown Implementation**: Created a DaisyUI dropdown menu displaying all projects with their names and change count badges for quick visual reference.

4. **Code Refactoring**: Removed the old tab-based project navigation and restructured the template to use a single-row layout with the dropdown and branch selector components.

5. **Final Output**: Delivered a cleaner, more compact Vue component that maintains all functionality while improving the UI by consolidating multiple project selection layers into an accessible dropdown interface.

history.summary:
# Summary

The user requested a refactor of the ChangesPanel component to replace the horizontal tab-based project selector with a more compact dropdown menu. The tabs were taking up excessive vertical space at the top of the panel. The solution implements a DaisyUI dropdown component that displays the selected project name and shows all available projects with their change counts in the dropdown menu. All existing functionality including branch selection, caching, and change loading was preserved, only the UI presentation layer was modified. This reduces visual clutter while maintaining the same feature set.

5. **Final Output**: Delivered a cleaner, more compact Vue component that maintains all functionality while improving the UI by consolidating multiple project selection layers into an accessible dropdown interface.
